senses.gloss: m. (נפס, נפץ) a kind of radish, resembling the carrot as to foliage, and the radish as to taste.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:3">Kil. I, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:5">5</cite>; Y. ed. a. Ms. M. <he>ס …</he> (Mish. a. Bab. ed. … <he>ץ</he>).
Ukts. I, 2. [Lat. napus is a kind of turnip.]
